Allergy.description: An allergy is an immune system reaction to substances such as pollen, dust, pet dander, or certain foods.
precautions: Wear a mask during high pollen seasons
Consult a doctor if symptoms worsen

Common Cold.description: A common viral infection affecting the nose and throat. It usually resolves within a week.

Fungal infection.description: A fungal infection is caused by fungi affecting the skin, nails, or other body parts.
